thread:
sam (eng-infra): Heads up — planning a terraform apply on the 'staging-2026-05' branch to split a few IAM roles and add an AZ egress rule. Change window 02:00-04:00 PT tonight. Need release notes + rollback plan. Any blockers?

maya (oncall): noted. I can watch. Can we canary on a subset of accounts/tenants first? prefer rolling AZ-by-AZ.

reuben (eng-sre): Please post a trimmed terraform plan output here. Also add a provider version pin to the modules to avoid drift during apply.

sam (eng-infra): plan is ready locally, uploading in a sec. Command we used:```terraform plan -var 'env=staging' -out=staging.plan```Deploy-bot: queue canary apply for group "staging-canary-1" once CI ok.

deploy-bot: queued apply job 98321 for canary group 'staging-canary-1'. ETA 02:15 PT. Reply with :thumbsup: to proceed to full rollout after canary.

ben (release-manager): I'll add a note in release notes: "IAM role split may cause transient credential refresh; tokens may need reissue for long-lived sessions." Will ping product for customer-facing wording.

lana (security): Heads up — KMS key rotation is scheduled for ~03:30 PT in staging. Confirm the IAM change doesn't modify key policies. If it does, we need an escape hatch.

sam (eng-infra): Escape hatch is documented in runbook: https://go/runbooks/iam-rollback . Quick rollback option: revert to snapshot state and run apply of previous state. For safety we'll take a state snapshot before canary: `aws s3 cp s3://tfstate/staging.tfstate s3://tfstate/snapshots/staging.tfstate.bak`

maya (oncall): I'll set a short-term alert: if 5xx rate >3% for 10m or token refresh errors spike, we hit rollback. I'll also monitor latencies.

reuben (eng-sre): Add required_providers pin in root module: ```required_providers { aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.50" } }``` and tag apply with `rollback-label=staging-2026-05` so automation knows which snapshot to restore.

ben (release-manager): Also publishing a short note to #product and #customer-notify before full rollout. Draft incoming in 15m.

sam (eng-infra): plan (trimmed): ```
+ aws_iam_role.split_role
+ aws_security_group.az-egress-rule
  # 3 resources to be added, 1 modified
```

deploy-bot: apply started for canary group at 02:18 PT. Job id 98321. Logs: https://deploys.corp/jobs/98321

maya (oncall): Canary finished — no errors in metrics, no 5xx spikes, token refresh trace ok. :thumbsup:

lana (security): Verified KMS logs around apply window, no policy writes. Clear from security side.

sam (eng-infra): Rolling to remainder of staging in 30m. If anyone sees issues speak up now. Pager on for infra team.

reuben (eng-sre): I'll kick off the full apply, using serial AZ batches and the provider pin applied.

ben (release-manager): Publishing release notes + internal changelog now. Will notify customer comms.

maya (oncall): Watching during full rollout. Rollback threshold set: 3% 5xx over baseline OR token refresh rate >4x.

sam (eng-infra): All good here. If rollback needed: call it, reference runbook, and tag the revert PR.

deploy-bot: full rollout started at 02:56 PT. Job id 98345. Monitor: https://deploys.corp/jobs/98345

maya (oncall): Full rollout complete, metrics healthy, closing window. Thanks team. :tada:
